protocol.family: Discrete monthly multinomial logistic, classes 0 none / 1 default / 2 payoff
protocol.rate_identification: Exclude spread from primary coefficient vector; retain full8 eligibility

preprocessing.numeric_imputation: Development risk-row median; one missing indicator per numeric
preprocessing.numeric_scaling: Development risk-row mean / population SD; constants scale1
preprocessing.categorical: Development-only sorted vocabulary; missing explicit token; drop first
preprocessing.unknown_category: All-zero reference encoding, separately counted, no evaluation fit
preprocessing.duration: Task9A bands, reference0-12; no knot/band changes
preprocessing.cohort: Task9A vintage indicators, reference2006; unrepresented effects zero and flagged

cif.landmarks: First eligible evaluation interval per facility
cif.future_macro: Historical rolling PIT paths, NOT entry-time known forecasts
cif.late_landmarks: Exclude per-horizon solely if full calendar path exceeds2026-02
cif.observed_reference: Aalen-Johansen, payoff competing event not censoring
cif.ipcw: Task6 pooled censor KM, conditional independent censoring assumed

sensitivities.updated_state_reason: Optional; omitted to isolate structural/macro research
sensitivities.heldout_effect: Zero relative training reference; if2006 heldout use2008

decision.primary: M2-M1 paired temporal joint log loss, smaller better
decision.positive: Both facility and calendar95 CI upper<0; cause Brier and absolute mean calibration error degradation<=1e-4
decision.mixed: Any paired proper-score improvement but positive criterion not satisfied

ledger.consume_once: All prespecified final temporal predictions in one sealed session
ledger.deterministic_replay: Verify-only replay of same frozen inputs/artifacts; no new fit/decision
